provenance.geometry: Local Blender crease-aware surface refinement plus modeled tapered hair, rolled lapels, sleeve/glove/waist seams and buckle. Original skeleton and animations unchanged.
provenance.body: Original 256px color interpolated in Blender to 2048px, small procedural cloth weave, roughness and normal detail. Not hand-painted or recovered detail.
provenance.face: AI-assisted face texture redraw constrained to original UV layout; reviewed on original mapped geometry.
provenance.limits: First-pass enhancement. Original body proportions, generic hands and old animation deformation remain. Not a full manual retopology or high-end sculpt.
